title: Grant Welfare
translation: O Goddess, grant welfare, grant the highest prosperity. Give me beauty, give me victory, give me glory, destroy my enemies.
translation_hi: हे देवी, कल्याण कीजिए, परम समृद्धि दीजिए। मुझे रूप दीजिए, जय दीजिए, यश दीजिए, शत्रुओं का नाश कीजिए।
grammar: Agreement: परमं सुखम् (neuter) in verse 12 but परमां श्रियम् (feminine) here: adjectives follow their noun's gender.
Refrain: रूपं देहि जयं देहि यशो देहि द्विषो जहि 'Give me beauty, give me victory, give me glory, destroy my enemies.'
